title: Mauritius Black River Gorges Route

waypoints.name: Le Morne
waypoints.advice: Le Morne is where the day begins. Next is Chamarel, 19 km on.

waypoints.name: Chamarel
waypoints.advice: Chamarel comes up 19 km in. Next is Black River Gorges viewpoint, 18 km on.

waypoints.name: Black River Gorges viewpoint
waypoints.advice: 37 km in you reach Black River Gorges viewpoint. Next is Grand Bassin, 19 km on.

waypoints.name: Grand Bassin
waypoints.advice: Grand Bassin, late in the day. Next is Curepipe, 18 km on.

waypoints.name: Curepipe
waypoints.advice: Back at Curepipe. That is the ride.

sections.advice: Le Morne → Chamarel is 9 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Chamarel → Black River Gorges viewpoint is 7 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Black River Gorges viewpoint → Grand Bassin is 7 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Grand Bassin → Curepipe is 15 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the named road Mauritius Black River Gorges Route. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.

scenicChapters.title: Mauritius Black River Gorges Route
scenicChapters.narrative: For 18 km this is Mauritius Black River Gorges Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Mauritius Black River Gorges Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 14 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
